name: script_newWorld
source: script built-ins newWorld and newWorldAlways share this function; net games gate it with newWorld_netGate

# addr: # ---- netcode: functions (hand-identified from strings/xrefs; names are mine) ----

name: net_frameLoop
source: lockstep main loop: runs sim tick, builds per-frame sync hash, compares with peers

name: net_frameLoop_hashBlock
source: inside net_frameLoop: hash = g_syncAcc + g_randSeed + sum((int)pos.xyz of each player)

name: net_frameLoop_compare
source: inside net_frameLoop: peer ring[frame&0xff] vs local -> sets peer+0x44d7, prints "out of SYNC"

name: net_frameLoop2
source: second site printing "Player %d is out of SYNC"

name: net_sendGameMsg
source: (conn, buf, len) - used for msg types 0x01,0x09,0x0a,0x0b,0x0c

name: net_getLocalPlayerSlot
source: (n) -> slot index of n-th local player

name: player_checksum
source: (slot, PlayerData*) anti-tamper checksum of selected character fields

name: game_setEvil
source: sets/clears that bit on every player

name: netmsg_0a_checksum_handler
source: case target: compares received player checksums, prints "CHECKSUM ERROR"

name: net_sendChecksums
source: builds msg 0x0a from player_checksum() of live + saved copy

name: hud_netStatusDraw
source: draws "Net Checksum Failure" (g_checksumFailed) and "<name> ... IS OUT OF SYNC!" (net_peerIsOutOfSync)

name: world_collectObjectsInBox
source: (min, max, out[], max) - used by script_reapEnemies

name: srs_getUdpManager
source: builds UdpManager::Params (defaults + overrides) and news the manager

name: g_networkMode
source: s8, nonzero in a net game

name: g_syncAcc
source: s32, added into the per-frame sync hash; zeroed in net_gameInit

name: g_netAckFrame
source: s32, net_frameLoop stalls when g_netFrame - this >= 31

name: g_randSeed
source: u32 LCG state: s = s*1664525 + 1013904223; ~194 inlined use sites

name: g_players
source: PlayerData[4], stride 0x4c30; +0x43d8 = GameObject* (pos floats at +0x10/+0x14/+0x18); +0x4c1a evil bits; +0x4c1b madeDecision bits

name: g_checksumFailed
source: set by netmsg_0a handler, drives "Net Checksum Failure"

name: g_peers
source: peer[4], stride 0x44e0; +0x18ac sync ring (256 x {frame, time, hash}); +0x44d4 isLocal; +0x44d7 outOfSync

name: g_localSyncRing
source: 256 x 12 bytes {frame, time, hash}, index = frame & 0xff

# addr: # ---- script VM (threaded code; opcode semantics are in tools/scr.py) ----

name: scr_relocate
source: loader: swaps opcodes for handler addresses (table 0x403150), relocates code operands

name: scr_interpret
source: computed-goto interpreter; called with NULL returns the handler table

name: vars_set
source: quest variable store, value clamped to a signed byte

name: g_questVars
source: packed table of name\0 value-byte entries; never sent over the network

name: game_resetState
source: clears quest vars, sets needPlayers=1; run on a fresh net launch

name: save_clearBuffer
source: zeroes the in-memory save area 0x895580 (0x4bc78 bytes) on a fresh net launch

name: save_build
source: 4 player structs + quest variable records into the save buffer

name: save_load
source: restores players and quest variables from the save buffer

name: save_game
source: called by Savepoint::run and script saveGame, in lockstep on every machine

name: game_checkAllDead
source: all players dead -> countdown -> schedules deathTask (also in net games with 2+ players)

name: deathTask
source: restart level with full HP, or save_load if the level has a checkpoint entry

# addr: # ---- cutscenes (.cut: header {flags, keyOff, nKeys, actorOff, nActors}; 20-byte keys {float t, s16 actor, s16 type, 3 x i32}) ----

name: cut_runFrame
source: per lockstep frame in net games; any player's pad bit 0x800 skips

name: cut_advance
source: runs each actor's run(), services pathfinding, executes keys with time <= clock

name: cut_execKey
source: actor -100 = camera, -99 = dialog/net wait, >=0 = level object (0 walk, 2 anim, 8 show, 10 teleport, 11 face)

name: script_gamePaused
source: script built-in: g_paused || jump-gate menu state (0x500ae8) || g_cutsceneActive

name: g_paused
source: s32; the only thing the net frame loop treats as paused

name: GameObject_rand
source: per-object LCG, state at object+0x44, seeded from g_randSeed in the constructor

name: g_cosmeticSeed
source: second LCG for particles; NOT in the sync hash; cutscenes reseed it from the frame counter

name: GameObject_ctor
source: draws one value from g_randSeed for the object's own seed

name: path_service
source: time-sliced pathfinding queue (128 entries at 0x7d43a8); 1 request per call

name: main_loop
source: net games tick only through net_main; draw tasks run every rendered frame

name: tasks_run
source: run-phase tasks once per simulated frame

name: Horsemen_ctor
source: class behind objects UndeadKnight1-4 (variant 0-3, no mount) and Rider* (mounted, BLOMEDAL only)

name: Horsemen_run
source: variants cast player skills: 0 DiseaseBolt, 1 FireStorm, 2 TagarsInsects, 3 SummonSkeleton

name: Nightmare_ctor
source: the mount; not created for UndeadKnight1-4

name: Cazic_ctor
source: object cazicavatar; casts FireStorm and SummonSkeleton

name: script_reapEnemies
source: script built-in: deletes (not kills) every object with flags&0x28==0x28 and !0x40; its three typeid tests compare against pointer types and can never match

name: g_skillTable
source: pointers to the static Skill objects (index 4 DiseaseBolt, 7 FireStorm, 11 SummonSkeleton, 87 TagarsInsects)

# addr: # ---- activity, camera and cutscene audio sync (added after the second static pass) ----

name: runObjects
source: run task prio 10: active list every frame, others every 15th/60th frame

name: obj_updateActive
source: (obj, wasActive, radius): near any player, or near g_cameraFocus when g_cullByCamera

name: Creature_updateActive
source: wrapper; several creature classes skip their AI when it returns 0

name: isNearView
source: (pos, radius): camera focus when g_cullByCamera, else any player; 14 gameplay callers

name: isNearCameraFocus480
source: camera only; all 7 callers are particle/effect code

name: gameSetObjectVis
source: first run task: builds activity centers; net games clear g_cullByCamera only when no cutscene is active

name: camera_updateFocus
source: g_cameraFocus = camera position + forward * 600; called by cut_runFrame and drawWorld

name: path_search
source: gives up for the frame when hardware timer T0 >= 7513 unless called in blocking mode

name: task_plotroute
source: run task prio 1000 (last): path_service(0) when no cutscene; followed by the blocking call in net_frameLoop

name: audio_streamPosition
source: blocking IOP RPC to the sound driver; local hardware timing

name: g_cutSpeaker
source: creature speaking the current dialog line; set in cut_execKey from the .dbin speaker name

name: g_cutAudioCorrection
source: float, +0.1 / -0.1 / 0; added to every animation track time of g_cutSpeaker each frame

name: Creature_draw
source: draw slot 5 body shared by all creatures; 0x10b898-0x10b8d4 decrements the first non-zero status counter at +0x36c (never index 12) when not frozen

name: Creature_run
source: common creature run; turns status counter 7 (+0x388) into slow amount +0x2fc; burn tick draws g_randSeed

name: Creature_clone
source: vtable slot 15; every handle list in the copy starts empty

name: Player_clone
source: vtable slot 15 of Player (0x590 bytes); used to make the prediction ghost

name: clone_50d590
source: slot 15 of the class with vtable 0x50d590 (0x3c8 bytes); not Player

name: Player_run
source: 30,324 bytes; runs for the prediction ghost too (flag 0x20000 guards)

name: Player_draw
source: skips the ghost during cutscenes; calls Player_interact in display mode

name: Player_dtor
source: skips global side effects when g_inGhostOp is set

name: Creature_dtor
source: deletes every spell in the +0x364 list

name: net_predictLocalPlayer
source: runs ghost run() for unconfirmed frames; restores only seed, hp +0xac, mana +0xc0, obj pointer

name: world_drawObjects
source: frustum cell walk; stops when render buffer < 3000 free; iterators take g_excludeMask

name: pad_apply
source: (pad, record, prevState): rewrites every pad field; 0x41bfc0 and 0x41c138 are never written

name: handle_initEmpty
source: the "copy constructor" of a handle list: writes 0

name: Player_processDamage
source: pending damage +0x2dc/+200 -> hp, stagger, death; runs for the ghost; PvP tail not ghost-guarded

name: Player_usePotion
source: ghost-guarded; menu path differs for the local player

name: Player_interact
source: (player, pad, displayOnly); sets g_scriptActivePlayer when used

name: Player_recalcDamage
source: x1.5 if status counter 2, x1.2 if counter 4

name: game_rebuildAlivePlayers
source: fills g_alivePlayerCount / g_alivePlayers and the local-only lists

name: Trigger_run
source: tests g_players[i].obj against the rectangle; sets g_scriptActivePlayer

name: newWorld_netGate
source: net game: refuses newWorld while active player's +0x4bca cooldown runs, else sets it to 600

name: Zek_run
source: Rallos Zek boss AI; creates objects on animation events

name: hud_run
source: run task; opens menus from the raw local pads

name: menu_openInventory
source: body runs only for the local slot; g_paused only offline

name: g_ghost
source: prediction copy of the local player (flag 0x20000)

name: g_forceGhostRebase
source: set by knockback, death, movement skills

name: g_inGhostOp
source: 1 while the ghost is predicted, deleted or cloned

name: g_rawPads
source: local controller state, edge bits consumed by the first sim tick of a frame
